targets.title: In for a penny, in for a pound: examining motivated memory through the lens of retrieved context models
targets.evidence_quote: The question of how motivation influences forgetting is important, and we therefore sought to replicate our previous work conceptually while making some changes to improve average performance in the delayed test.
targets.outcome_quote: In this preregistered study, we replicated a null effect of reward on forgetting in cued free recall.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit verdict confirms the central null effect on forgetting. A new immediate-test decrease in pure-list recall is noted as an additional finding rather than a failure of the central replication.
